name: Blackstump Solutions
summary: Regional telecom/ISP (ADSL1/2 broadband + fixed-line + VoIP bundles, from ~2005); retail site alive to 2011, hosting disabled by 2012, dead c. 2011.

events.details: Telecommunications provider; ADSL1/ADSL2 broadband, fixed-line telephone and VoIP; earliest Wayback capture Aug 2006.
Full retail homepage still live Feb 2011; by Feb 2012 the site returned an InterWorx 'Site Disabled' (hosting suspended) page, parked thereafter.
